# davidfacer.com

The professional site of one person, David Facer: enterprise
architecture and AI-native operating practice. The practice's models and
assessments are published separately, at aimaturitymodels.com (below).

This file is a guide for automated readers. It says what exists here and
where. It does not reproduce the site — every page below serves its own
readable text, except where marked CARRIED, which means the page itself
delivers nothing to a reader without a browser and the substance is
given here instead.

WRITTEN BY HAND on 2026-09-12, last revised 2026-10-18. It is not
generated from anything, so it can go stale. If a line here disagrees with the page it describes, the
page is right.

---

## Professional

/professional/cv/
  Full curriculum vitae: roles, dates, scope of responsibility.
  Substantial, and the most detailed single document on this domain.
  Serves its own text.

## Prototypes

/sampleprototypes/
  Index page describing the working prototypes. Serves its own text.
  One is on this domain, the assessment below; the others are on a
  separate subdomain:

  https://prototypes.davidfacer.com/dinotherapy
    Dinosaur Comics Therapy. A small interactive piece.

  https://prototypes.davidfacer.com/nhltradesignal
    NHL Trade Signal Dashboard. A data dashboard over NHL trade
    activity. Serves substantial text.

## Prototype on this domain

/complexity-sovereignty-assessment/
  CARRIED — this page is a client-rendered application. It returns an
  empty document shell to anything that does not execute JavaScript, so
  a pointer alone would send you to a blank page. What it is:

  The Economic Complexity & Sovereignty Assessment is a prototype that
  applies an assessment method to nations. Each country in its dataset
  is scored for economic complexity and for sovereignty and strategic
  autonomy, with a reading of the gap between the two and the
  constraint that binds it. It is free to use.

  A reader that can execute JavaScript should load the page itself;
  this summary is not a substitute for it.

---

## Related sites, separately published

https://aimaturitymodels.com
  The AI-Native Maturity Model family: open maturity models, each with
  a whole-model view and a free self-assessment, plus Strata, the architectural
  governance plane, and a set of function models. Its own
  map, below, lists the models; this file does not, so that it cannot
  fall behind them. This is a separate site with its own content.

  It publishes its own files for AI readers: a map, and the full text
  in one file, which CARRIES the model content in full:

    https://aimaturitymodels.com/llms.txt       the map
    https://aimaturitymodels.com/llms-full.txt  the full text

  An automated reader wanting the models themselves should fetch the
  full text, not this file.

https://maturitymodel.substack.com/
  Substack publication. External platform, separately published.

## Notes for automated readers

- Everything listed here is public. Nothing on this domain requires
  sign-in to read.
- /sitemap.xml lists this domain's main pages. It does not list the
  prototype destinations above, which are on a subdomain.
  This file is the more complete inventory of the two.
- No identifier is named here that a reader cannot follow. Where this
  practice has internal documents, they are not referenced.
